description: Observe the current page with the native Playwright AI-mode ARIA snapshot, including visible iframe id/name and reachable nested frame bodies. Returns a string without action refs, plus exact conditional frame observation evidence. This is distinct from DOM-CUA decimal node ids and browser.snapshot AX refs. Frame expansion has a shared1000ms budget and500ms per frame, may scroll while resolving a frame, and never retries unavailable frame bodies. target_id addresses an already-owned page without selecting or focusing it.

timeout_ms.description: Root observation maximum3000ms. Nested visible frame expansion has a shared1000ms deadline and at most500ms per frame, with unavailable/expired frames explicitly recorded.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
